description: Whole-archive entry name checks (SPEC Section 5.4, 1.2.0). `entries` lists stored names in order; a name ending in `/` is a directory entry. An archive is valid when no two entries are equal after NFC normalization (ERR_DUPLICATE_PATH) and no file's path is also a directory of another entry (ERR_PATH_CONFLICT). Non-ASCII names are written as JSON \u escapes so normalization differences stay visible. Names that differ only in case are valid (SHOULD NOT, not MUST NOT); consumers may warn.

cases.name: names differing only in case are valid
cases.note: Section 5.4 SHOULD NOT; consumers may warn about extraction collisions (Section 13.1).

cases.name: a file that is also a directory is rejected
a file that is also a directory entry is rejected
a file and a directory equal after NFC are rejected
a nested file that is also a directory is rejected
